rollforward.notes: Source: audited DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT, p52 (financial period 12 Aug 2025 (date of constitution) to 31 Dec 2025). The statement lists only: opening line (blank) -> Profit after tax 9,695 -> Adjustment for non-tax items (A) 20,300 -> 'Amount available for distribution to Unitholders' 29,995 -> closing line (blank). (A) opening 'Amount available for distribution to Unitholders at beginning of the financial period' is DISCLOSED-AS-BLANK; set 0 by construction as CAREIT was constituted 12 Aug 2025 with no prior period (flagged, not plugged; opening carry is definitionally nil). (B) net_distributable_income = 29,995k = the for-period subtotal 'Amount available for distribution to Unitholders' (9,695 + 20,300), NOT a cumulative line (there is no opening carry) and NOT after-retention; confirmed vs existing extract. (P) distribution_cash_paid set 0: the Distribution Statement has NO distribution-paid/'to be distributed' line; the Statement of Movements in Unitholders' Funds (p55) shows full retention of the 9,695 profit and zero distribution outflow; Note 32 Events after reporting date (p74) states the FP2025 distribution of 1.739 cents/unit was only DECLARED on 23 Feb 2026 (after year-end), so cash paid during the period is nil (flagged, cross-verified, not plugged). (E) closing 'Amount available for distribution to Unitholders at end of the financial period' is DISCLOSED-AS-BLANK; nulled (would economically equal the undistributed 29,995k, but no numeric value is stated -> NOT plugged). distribution_paid_declared nulled: audited Note 32 (p74) discloses DPU 1.739 cents declared 23 Feb 2026 for FP2025 but no S$ amount; the S$29,953k 'Amount to be distributed to Unitholders' figure appears only in Financial Highlights (excluded per AR-audited-only rule). GUARD: A+B-P = 0+29,995-0 = 29,995k, which matches the economically-implied closing; guard_ok=null because E is not numerically disclosed in the audited statement, so the A+B-P==E identity is unverifiable (not broken -> no mis-read to fix).
